title: Blue Succubus Love Magic
description: A blue-skinned female demon with horns and purple hair stands confidently in front of a chalkboard labeled 'Love Magic 101'. She wears a pinstripe suit jacket over a corset top and a bat-patterned skirt, with one hand on her hip and the other presenting a glowing pink kiss, surrounded by floating envelopes, hearts, and magical symbols.
prompt: A blue-skinned succubus with curved horns, long blue-purple hair, and glowing eyes stands in a seductive pose with one hand on her hip, wearing a black pinstripe suit jacket, purple corset vest with heart pins, and a black skirt covered in bat and spiderweb patterns. She holds out her hand with a giant glowing pink kiss floating above it. Behind her is a dark chalkboard filled with magical symbols, hearts, the text 'LOVE MAGIC 101', 'x + desire = infinity', 'kiss + shadow = eternal', and 'mwah!'. Scattered around are floating love letters with wax seals, bats, and purple flames. Moody atmospheric lighting with glowing elements and sparkles, dark gothic fantasy style.
